author: reek
body: CompilerDriver is the self-hosted compiler driver. CompilerDriver replaces the PS1 orchestration scripts (sample-compile-selfhost.ps1, pingpong-self.ps1, sweep.ps1) with Codex-native logic. The driver runs on the Codex OS ? the compiler invokes itself via process-spawn to compile samples and verify the fixed point.

author: reek
body: On bare metal with the scheduler, a compile is just: spawn a process that reads source from a file, compiles the source, and writes the output binary. No QEMU, no TCP sockets, no PS1.

author: reek
body: The compiler compiling itself. Reads the source tree via SourceConcat, feeds the source to the compiler, and captures the output CDX. This is the core of pingpong.

author: reek
body: Compile a single sample and evaluate the result against its sidecar. This is the inner loop of sweep.
